devPanel.title: Dev Panel
devPanel.hint: Internal page for developers. Enter your login and password to continue.
devPanel.panelLead: Available to development team members only. Do not use for production system data.
devPanel.mustChangePassword: You signed in with a temporary password. Set a new one (at least 12 characters).

metrics.historyHint: Sampled every {seconds} s and kept in memory; resets when the application restarts

audit.noLogs: No logs found for this trace (the log files may have been removed or rotated)
audit.truncated: Too many entries, only the first {count} are shown

query.hint: A single SELECT only, run in a read-only transaction (30 s timeout). System schemas are off limits.
query.updateConfirm: This will modify the database. Continue?
query.noWriteAccess: This account has no write access (READ_WRITE required)

updateRules.single: Only one UPDATE per request. INSERT, DELETE, DDL and multiple statements separated by ";" are rejected.
updateRules.where: WHERE is required. To update every row, write WHERE true.
updateRules.returning: RETURNING is not supported — run a SELECT afterwards to check the result.
updateRules.limit: If more than 1000 rows change, everything is rolled back and an error is returned.
updateRules.tables: dev_* and databasechangelog* tables cannot be modified.
updateRules.timeout: Queries running longer than 30 seconds are cancelled.

files.name: File
files.empty: No files for the selected period

preview.unsupported: This file can't be previewed in the browser — download it instead

accounts.resetConfirm: Reset the password of {username}? A new temporary password will be issued.
accounts.temporaryHint: This password is shown only once. Pass it to the user — they will have to set a new one when signing in.
accounts.usernamePattern: 3–64 characters: Latin letters, digits, dot, _ and -

devPanel.subtitle: Developer console

jvm.filter: Filter by name, state or class

twoFactor.setupHint: Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator (or Authy, Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows. Every login needs this code.
twoFactor.codeHint: Open Google Authenticator and enter the 6-digit code for Dev Panel.
twoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.resetConfirm: {username} will be logged out and must scan a new QR code at the next login. Continue?

health.allGood: All good — everything is within normal limits

api.hint: Times are p50/p95/p99 response times; compare = p95 of the last hour
api.nPlusOneHint: One request ran the same SQL again and again — usually related data loaded row by row. Wasted = repeats beyond the first, over all repeated statements.
api.tracesHint: Kept: slow, failed and N+1 requests, plus one recent request per endpoint per minute. Click a row.

errors.hint: The same exception from the same place is one row. NEW: never seen before this start.

integrations.hint: Calls to other systems (Feign, RestTemplate) since the start

jobs.hint: @Scheduled methods: last run, duration, failures, and jobs that did not run on time

alerts.deliveryFailed: The last message could not be delivered
alerts.setupHint: No channel is set up. Create a bot with @BotFather, write to it once, get your chat id from @userinfobot, then add to devpanel.properties:

logLevels.hint: Change a logger's level while the app runs; it goes back by itself after the chosen time.
logLevels.thenBack: then the configured level comes back

config.hint: The values the application really uses, and where each came from. Secrets are masked.

security.enrolledHint: If you don't remember setting it up then and there, ask the super admin to reset your 2FA.

database.unusedHint: Never used since statistics were reset; they slow down every write.
database.leaksHint: Connections held longer than the leak threshold; the stack shows the code that took the connection.
database.cancelConfirm: Stop the statement of PID {pid}? The connection stays open.
database.killConfirm: Close connection PID {pid}? Its transaction is rolled back.

memory.title: Memory leak detection
memory.histogramConfirm: This runs a full garbage collection first, which pauses the application briefly. Continue?
memory.floorChart: Heap left after each garbage collection (lowest per 10 min)
memory.leak: Possible memory leak: memory left after GC keeps rising
memory.leakEta: Possible memory leak: at this pace the heap is full in about {hours} h
memory.collecting: Collecting data — needs about an hour of garbage collections
memory.stable: Stable — no sign of a leak

waterfall.title: Request waterfall: where the time went
waterfall.repeated: {wasted} repeated queries (N+1) — the same statement run many times:
waterfall.noSpans: No SQL or external calls in this request
waterfall.truncated: Only the first 400 steps are shown

usage.activeHint: Users with a request in the last 5 minutes
usage.unusedHint: {count} of {total} endpoints had no call since {since}: candidates for dead code (check scheduled or rare yearly use first).

threats.note: Detects attacks that reach the application (floods from a few addresses, password guessing, scanning). A large network DDoS never reaches it and must be blocked in nginx, the firewall or by the provider; use the addresses below for that.
threats.findings: What looks like an attack now

deps.title: Availability checks (every minute)
deps.hint: Pinged even without traffic, so you know a service is down before users hit it.

deployReport.title: This deploy vs the week before ({minutes} min running)
